notes.title: 10/11 Left-Handed VR Mode Update [Full + Demo]
notes.content:
VR Changes
You can now enable left-handed mode in the Wristwatch > Settings > Controls tab.

notes.title: 03/11 Update [Full + Demo]
notes.content:
Added an HP and AP bar. The AP bar has an indicator to show when the secondary "power" shot is ready.
 Added tutorial-like hints that show the most important keybinds.


VR Changes
 Thumbstick Jump & Crouch should now work with Virtual Desktop's VDXR.

notes.title: 01/11 Subtitle Update (v1.0.8)
notes.content: Dave's subtitles are now localized in all languages!

notes.title: 01/11 Update
notes.content:
Reduced the damage radius of the Poppy Cutter.
 Fixed an issue with overlapping music playing.
 The hoverboard can now be summoned anywhere.
 Added force feedback when taking damage and interacting with the inventory.
 Reduced Guilt's laser grid damage - it will still kill you, don't worry.
 Added a few puzzle hints.

 

VR CHANGES

 Added a weapon wheel to select the active module when holding L-Trigger. Short-pressing the trigger will now switch between the current and last weapon. This makes combat much more fun!
 The aim-assist laser can now be toggled off from the Wristwatch > Video settings.
 Added a UI widget that pops up next to the left hand when you are parrying.

notes.title: 27/10 Demo Update
notes.content:
Added additional accessibility markers (orange interaction indicators).
 Misc. small changes.

VR Changes

 Added a new input preset for VR.
 Added touch interaction to all interactables (buttons, PDAs, etc).


Thanks to community members Silverfire32, Fixarfrasse and Moriar for the feedback to put this update together.

notes.title: 20/10 Demo Update
notes.content:
Added a new setting "Detail Distance" to increase the LOD distances.
 You can now use the Wardrobe Ticket from the inventory to trigger the Receptionist interaction.
 The Guilt lasergrid attack only comes from the front now.
 The Guilt blind attack timing has been relaxed.
 Misc. small changes.


VR Changes

 Removed water droplet effect.
 Swapped "Crouch" and "Next Weapon" bindings.
 Disabled refraction on translucent shards which caused artifacts.
 Item tooltips are now shown when hovering over them in the inventory.


Thank you to Greendayle and plaisi for helping with this update!

notes.title: VR Fixes
notes.content:
VR Changes

 Changed the default height. You can reset the view with Wristwatch > Settings > Video > Reset View.
 PDA displays now face the camera instead of each eye.
 Changed Valve Index bindings to use Grip Force as a trigger.

notes.title: 14/10 Demo Update
notes.content:
Added localization support for Chinese (Simplified), Russian, German, Portuguese (Brazil) and Japanese.
 Added support for pausing the game when the gamepad disconnects or the Steam Overlay is opened.
 Changed dialogs to only be initiated when looking at the characters.
 Misc. smaller changes.


VR Changes

 Added a setting to adjust the player height.

notes.title: 15/09 Demo Update
notes.content:
Added PDAs which contain more information about the story.
 Added an animated loading screen with gameplay tips.
 Updated the plasma blaster sound.
 Fixed missing gamepad input icons.
 Misc. smaller fixes.
 

VR Changes

 Improved the performance significantly when running on default settings.
 Improved the readability (sharper, less smearing) of the in-game UI.
 Misc. smaller fixes.

notes.title: 14/07 Demo Update
notes.content:
Mouse buttons can now be reassigned in the control settings.
 Settings sliders now display their numerical values.


VR Changes

 Enabled Instanced Stereo Rendering to increase performance.
 Added control settings to enable aim smoothing.
 Added a video setting to enable seated mode.
 Added a wristwatch that opens the inventory when you look at it. The system button is no longer needed and can be used for the SteamVR dashboard.

notes.title: 11/05 Demo Update
notes.content:
Fixed using items from the inventory in VR.
 Fixed quitting from the exit door in VR.
 Adjusted the placement of facial attachments, such as the bowtie, in VR.
 Misc. smaller fixes.

notes.title: 29/04 Demo Update
notes.content:
The UI has been revamped.
 Parrying will now deal melee damage, it's a 2-in-1.
 The maximum input sensitivity has been doubled.

notes.title: 23/04 Demo Update
notes.content:
Energy cans are now yellow, matching the color of the energy bar.
An extra hint has been added for the snowman puzzle.
The Blaster display will now turn red when the power shot is not available.
Usable items now display an "active" adorner icon next to them.
Some environment layouts have been changed to draw more attention.
Status effects are now more prominently displayed.
Quick Load menu hotkey fixed.


Future updates might refine some of these changes.

notes.title: 20/04 Demo Update
notes.content:
Simplified the bowtie puzzle and added more hints.
 Simplified the first jumping challenge - dying immediately is not fun.
 Permadeath now starts a new game instead of returning to the main menu.
